transport: PixelLab MCP via mcp-remote and https://api.pixellab.ai/mcp
reason: VIS-204–210 v1 had inconsistent corners, noisy borders, and visibly repeated stretch bands when used as nine-patch UI.

style_reference.description: A contact sheet assembled from the approved PixelLab gameplay sprites and palette. It is supplied only as a style reference.

request.color_palette: warm cream #FFF8E7, dark plum #302846, mint #D9F2DD, coral #FF8F9D, peach #FFC6A5, sky blue #BCE8F5
request.description: One cohesive blank pixel-art UI kit sheet for Tumble Toy, a cute handmade toy-block puzzle game. Extremely clean, restrained and readable at small mobile size. All seven pieces use the same perfectly symmetrical 2-pixel dark-plum outline, simple rounded corners, large uninterrupted flat centers, and only one 1-pixel inner highlight plus one 2-pixel bottom shadow. Panel: warm cream with a very thin mint inner edge. Default button: warm cream with mint highlight. Primary button: coral face with pale-cream highlight. Pressed button: muted mint face with a dark-plum one-pixel inset at the top. View tab: pale sky-blue face with a thin coral selected underline. Direction button: warm cream face, mint edge, peach bottom shadow. Item slot: warm cream center with a thin peach inset. Every corner of a given piece must be identical and every long edge must have a completely flat repeatable middle section suitable for nine-slice stretching. No text, letters, numbers, icons, arrows, symbols, checkerboard, stripes, stitches, corner ornaments, random pixels, texture noise, gradients, gaps, asymmetry, extra objects, or background.

outputs.postprocess: The MCP sheet's dark-teal center and teal edge were mapped to the approved cream and mint palette so dark-plum code text remains readable.
